tools.name: solar_states
tools.description: Lists every state in the GreenLight plug-in (balcony) solar registry with its legal status, law name, power cap, and verification state, plus a count of entries by verification state. Takes no input. GreenLight records enacted law only, verified field-by-field against the enrolled bill text; entries

tools.name: solar_law
tools.description: Returns the full GreenLight registry record for one state's plug-in (balcony) solar law: legal status, the law's name and dates, key provisions as recorded (power cap, certification requirement, utility notice, renter/HOA treatment), citations with official-text URLs where the verification pass atta
